items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: Percy Humphries, I'm very impressed with Percy as a fellow who just plays the music very, very naturally as it occurs to him.

ctx.x: It's very, very natural the way he plays. Jim Robinson, to my mind, plays just as well if not better now every night than as on records he made 20 years ago. It's great. He's been one of the highlights listening. Percy Humphries, I'm very impressed with Percy as a fellow who just plays the music very, very naturally as it occurs to him. Some nights he blows out, other nights he plays very casually but always very, very nicely.
Well, you were saying he impressed the crowd last night with certain ways of playing. Yes.
